title: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but
question: List all the names of events that had an attendance of over 20 students but were not fundraisers.

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event_attendance AS T1
WHERE T1.type <> 'Fundraiser'
  AND (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM event_attendance AS T2
    WHERE T2.event_id = T1.event_id
  ) > 20

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT T1.event_name
FROM event_attendance AS T1
GROUP BY T1.event_id
HAVING COUNT(T1.link_to_member) > 20 AND T1.type != 'Fundraiser'
